comment: Phase 3 — api-key credential-mediation route. Sorts BEFORE 01-mcp-olb (whose ^/mcp(?!/invest) would otherwise capture /mcp/apikey) so it wins for the dedicated /mcp/apikey path the BFF now targets for api-key tools. Inbound OAuth token is validated (ApiKeyResourceServerFilter), then p1az-decision.groovy runs the PingOne Authorize decision — parity with the Node gateway, whose HTTP pipeline (runMcpAuthorizationPipeline) authorizes api-key tools before apiKeyDispatch. On PERMIT the terminal apikey-dispatch handler pulls the vault service key via the BFF bridge and calls demo_data_service with X-API-Key. IG's Entity is re-readable, so p1az-decision and the handler both read request.entity.string (same idiom as route 01-mcp-olb). Schema validation (mcp-request-validation) is deliberately NOT added here: show_investment is absent from mcp-tool-schemas.json, so schema validation would -32602 it; p1az-decision parses the body independently and does not reject on unknown-tool.
name: mcp-apikey-dispatch
